feedback: The implementation does not fully satisfy the listed requirements. Add missing Open Graph and canonical meta tags in SEO, update sitemap to include /systems and /engagements, ensure ArchitectureDiagram renders title and desc in prerendered HTML, and adjust Engagements page styling and markup to meet design token specifications and ordering expectations. Also ensure all photo rendering constraints and tokens are correctly applied across the site.
unproven:
The Engagements page renders tier cards as
elements with id attributes, but the acceptance tests expect the Enterprise tier card to be an
. The task only requires the enterprise card to have id "enterprise"; however, the test also checks for a Premium label and for an with src containing "enterprise-atrium". The current implementation fulfills these but incorrectly places the Premium label inside the .tier-body instead of as a separate visual element as required by design tokens, and the layout does not ensure the
element is styled with the required navy background and teal outline (dark card). The test also expects the "Not sure which fits?" line to be after the tiers, but the current component renders it inside a separate
that may not follow the tier elements due to extra whitespace or missing wrapping, causing possible ordering failures.

The site sitemap (public/sitemap.xml) includes only five pages (/, /services, /training, /about, /contact) but the requirements R192-R194 require seven pages, including /systems and /engagements. The current sitemap does not list these pages, causing a failure of requirement R194.

The ArchitectureDiagram component inserts <title> and <desc> elements only after mount (client-side), relying on aria-label for prerendered state. However, requirement R41 expects the diagram to have a title and desc for screen readers in the prerendered HTML. Since they are missing in prerendered output, the requirement is not fully met.
